Usage: kali-tools [global flags] <command> [flags]
Commands:
  version          Show version and build platform
  doctor           Show capabilities and optional dependencies
  capabilities     List capabilities and availability states
  tools            List separately installed optional tools
  neighbors        Read the passive OS ARP/ND cache
  interfaces       List local network interfaces
  inventory        Show routes, DNS and traffic counters
  diagnose         diagnose [dns|tcp|http|tls|ping|trace] [flags]
  discover         Discover a bounded IPv4 scope
  inspect          Inspect services with separately installed Nmap
  wifi             Show current Wi-Fi metadata
  wifi show        Show current Wi-Fi metadata
  wifi reveal      Print the saved key only with --confirm
  jobs list        List active jobs; --all includes terminal history
  jobs show        Show a job by its 32-character ID
  jobs cancel      Cancel a job started in this process
  history list     List redacted diagnostic history
  history clear    Clear terminal history; keep active jobs
  settings get     Show language and retention settings
  settings set     Update language or retention settings
  capture live     Capture bounded traffic with an optional backend
  capture import   Import a PCAP or PCAPNG file
  capture export   Convert a packet file to an explicit destination
  serve            Serve the shared UI (implemented by W01/W04)
  capture          Capture bounded traffic with an optional backend
  import           Import a PCAP or PCAPNG file
Global flags: --json --timeout --no-color --lang
